#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;

long long fastpow(long long n, long long ti) {
    long long res = 1;
    n %= MOD;
    while (ti > 0) {
        if (ti & 1) res = (res * n) % MOD;
        n = (n * n) % MOD;
        ti >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

vector<long long> fac;

long long ncr(int n, int k) {
    if (n < k) return 0;
    long long num = fac[n];
    long long den = (fac[n - k] * fac[k]) % MOD;
    long long invDen = fastpow(den, MOD - 2);
    return (num * invDen) % MOD;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    fac.resize(200001);
    fac[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < (int)fac.size(); i++) {
        fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * i) % MOD;
    }

    int n;
    long long k;
    cin >> n >> k;

    if (k >= n) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << fac[n] << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    if (k == n - 1) {
        cout << (2LL * n) % MOD << "\n";
        return 0;
    }

    int filledCols = (int)(n - k);
    long long waysToChooseFilledCols = ncr(n, filledCols);
    long long ans = 0;

    for (int emptyCols = 0; emptyCols <= filledCols; emptyCols++) {
        long long waysToChoose = ncr(filledCols, emptyCols);
        long long waysToFill = fastpow(filledCols - emptyCols, n);
        long long val = (waysToChoose * waysToFill) % MOD;
        if (emptyCols % 2 == 1) {
            val = (MOD - val) % MOD;
        }
        ans = (ans + val) % MOD;
    }

    ans = (ans * waysToChooseFilledCols) % MOD;
    ans = (ans * 2) % MOD;

    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
